subject.title: [Feature]: Per-session activity state (busy/idle + awaiting_user, awaiting_subagent) via gateway API + WS statechange

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new gateway-owned `sessions.activity` public contract with explicit runtime activity, attention, stale-run, and child-rollup semantics, and require related PRs to align to that contract before merge?
rationale: This is a public Gateway/session-state API and websocket contract, not a narrow bug fix; automation cannot choose the durable semantics, persistence rules, or plugin/API boundary safely.

options.title: Accept Canonical Gateway Activity API
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design item and require implementation PRs to provide the full get/list, event, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, docs, and tests contract.

options.title: Narrow To Coarse Status Surfacing
options.body: Decline the broader API for now and let narrower `sessions.list` or Control UI status work proceed without promising attention or child-rollup semantics.

options.title: Defer Until A Sponsored Design
options.body: Keep related PRs paused and ask for a maintainer-sponsored protocol design before adding any new public session activity surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Canonical Gateway Activity API
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical design item and require implementation PRs to provide the full get/list, event, attention, stale-run, child-rollup, docs, and tests contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The live issue is assigned to vincentkoc and the affected surface is Gateway/protocol session state.
